vocabulary.meaning_en: friendly, light conversation with someone you don't know well
vocabulary.example: We made small talk on the plane.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person in the seat next to you

vocabulary.example: I'm excited but a little nervous.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a holiday; time off for travel or rest

vocabulary.example: I'm going home after my business trip.

vocabulary.meaning_en: change from a child to an adult in a place
vocabulary.example: I grew up in New York.
I want to see the famous buildings.
I love the energy of the city.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used to start a new topic
vocabulary.example: By the way, what do you do?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a teacher of students aged about 14 to 18
a company that makes computer programs

vocabulary.meaning_en: do something again and again to get better

fine_lines.title: Where are you from? vs Where do you live?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: Where are you from? = ما بلدك الأصلي؟ Where do you live? = أين تسكن الآن؟
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Where are you from?" = your home country. "Where do you live?" = your home now.

fine_lines.title: What do you do? vs What are you doing?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: What do you do? = ما عملك؟ What are you doing? = ماذا تفعل الآن؟
fine_lines.explanation_en: "What do you do?" asks about your job. "What are you doing?" asks about now.

expressions.phrase: Hi. I think we're seatmates. I'm Alex.
expressions.meaning_ar: مرحبًا. أظن أننا جاران في المقعد. أنا أليكس.
expressions.meaning_en: Starting a conversation on a plane.
expressions.example: Hi, I think this is my seat. I'm Omar.

expressions.phrase: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you, too.
expressions.example: Nice to meet you, Yuki. Nice to meet you, too.

expressions.phrase: Is this your first time going to New York?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل هذه أول مرة تذهب إلى نيويورك؟
expressions.example: Is this your first time in London?

expressions.phrase: Where are you from? / I'm from Japan.
expressions.meaning_ar: من أين أنت؟ / أنا من اليابان.
expressions.example: Where are you from? I'm from Egypt.

expressions.phrase: What made you decide to visit New York?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما الذي جعلك تقرر زيارة نيويورك؟
expressions.example: What made you decide to learn English?

expressions.phrase: I've always wanted to see the famous buildings.
expressions.meaning_en: A wish you had for a long time.
expressions.example: I've always wanted to visit Mecca.

expressions.phrase: What do you like most about living there?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما أكثر ما تحبه في العيش هناك؟
expressions.example: What do you like most about your job?

expressions.phrase: How long is the flight? / About 13 hours.
expressions.example: How long is the flight to Dubai?

expressions.phrase: Do you usually sleep on planes? / Not really.
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تنام عادةً في الطائرات؟ / ليس كثيرًا.
expressions.example: Do you usually eat breakfast? Not really.

expressions.phrase: By the way, what do you do?
expressions.example: By the way, what do you do? I'm a nurse.

expressions.phrase: Your English is very good. / Thank you. I practice every day.
expressions.meaning_ar: لغتك الإنجليزية جيدة جدًا. / شكرًا، أتدرب كل يوم.

expressions.example: You can show me the city? That would be amazing.

grammar.title: Present perfect: I've always wanted to ...
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم I've always wanted to + فعل لرغبة قديمة مستمرة حتى الآن.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "I've always wanted to + verb" for a wish you have had for a long time.
examples: I've always wanted to see New York.
She has always wanted to be a doctor.
I've always wanted to learn Japanese.

grammar.title: Adverbs of frequency: usually, always, never
grammar.explanation_ar: ظروف التكرار تأتي قبل الفعل الأساسي: I usually read. وبعد فعل be: I am always late.
grammar.explanation_en: Frequency adverbs go before the main verb, but after "be".
examples: I usually watch films or read.

questions.explanation_en: The adverb goes before the verb.

choices: Thank you. I practice every day.
questions.explanation_en: A polite answer to a compliment.
